one_liner: Sentry has a broad REST web API (v0) that works with self-serve auth tokens. A free tier is reported to work for testing. OAuth appears partner-registered on the provided pages, and the MCP server is not confirmed by them.
auth_notes: Self-serve Auth Tokens are sent as a Bearer header. OAuth2 is documented, but the provided OAuth page says Sentry must register the app via its partnership team first. Sentry Apps OAuth was not covered by the pages. Basic auth with legacy API keys is described as deprecated, so I dropped BASIC. The partner provisioning API uses HMAC signing and is partner-only.
access_notes: Nango's access table says a free tier is available for testing, and that partnership and app review are not required. Whether the free plan has full API access is only indirectly supported. Region-specific hosts such as us.sentry.io and de.sentry.io are available.
blocker_notes: Each customer must create and paste an auth token. A managed multi-user OAuth flow may need partnership registration, according to the provided OAuth page. The official MCP claim is retained from background knowledge, since none of the provided pages confirm it.

evidence.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
Sentry uses API_KEY auth mode with `authorization: Bearer <Auth Token>` in the request header
Sentry offers both `Auth Tokens` and Basic Auth with `API Keys`(Deprecated) for authentication
Before implementing OAuth, Sentry must register your application. Contact our partnership team with:
| Paid test account | ✅ | Free tier available for testing |
Generate an Auth Token with required scopes
